Our services span from concept development through post-production, ensuring that we provide an end-to-end solution for all visual production needs. We have earned the trust of globally recognized brands and government agencies by consistently delivering compelling content with a commitment to quality, professionalism, and inclusivity.

MWBE Certification

As an MWBE-certified company, FortyLove is committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in the workforce. This certification allows us to participate in government contracting opportunities, where MWBE engagement is prioritized, and enables clients to meet their diversity goals. We ensure that every project not only reflects high standards of craftsmanship but also promotes equitable representation, both in front of and behind the camera.

Our Services

FortyLove offers a wide range of photo and video production services, catering to the unique needs of commercial and government clients. Our expertise extends to various types of projects, including branding campaigns, public service announcements, product shoots, corporate events, and more. Below are our primary service offerings:

1. Commercial Photo and Video Production
We work with brands across industries to create visually stunning content that enhances their message and engages their target audience. Our commercial services include:

Advertising Campaigns: Creating eye-catching visuals that build brand awareness.
Product Photography & Videography: Highlighting product features and quality for marketing purposes.
Corporate Videos: Producing company profiles, testimonials, and internal communication content.
Event Coverage: Documenting key moments at corporate events, launches, and trade shows.
Social Media Content: Generating dynamic visuals optimized for social platforms.
Fashion & E-commerce Photography: Crafting professional lookbooks and product images that drive sales.
2. Government Photo and Video Production
FortyLove is experienced in working with government agencies to produce content that meets strict compliance and quality standards. Our government services include:

Public Service Announcements (PSAs): Communicating important messages to the public.
Training Videos: Creating instructional content for employees and the public.
Documentary Production: Capturing critical social, political, and environmental issues.
Infrastructure Documentation: Recording the progress of public works and infrastructure projects.
Event Documentation: Providing professional coverage of government events and initiatives.
Emergency Response & Preparedness Videos: Helping public safety departments communicate important guidelines.
As a certified MWBE, we ensure all diversity and inclusion goals are met in compliance with state and federal regulations, making us an ideal partner for government contracting.

3. End-to-End Production Services
We offer comprehensive production services that cover every aspect of a project, from pre-production planning to final delivery. Our full-service capabilities include:

Pre-Production: Creative development, budgeting, casting, location scouting, and permitting.
Production: On-set photography and videography, drone filming, and live-streaming.
Post-Production: Professional editing, sound design, color grading, motion graphics, and VFX.
We also handle all necessary compliance, ensuring that each project meets regulatory standards, particularly in the case of government contracts or productions involving minors.

4. Specialized Services
Multilingual Content: We produce content in various languages, ensuring it resonates with diverse audiences.
Green Production: Offering eco-friendly production practices for clients focused on sustainability.
Government Contracting: Our expertise in public sector work and MWBE certification makes us a trusted partner for government agencies.

business_description:
Founded in 1992, Artech provides comprehensive Workforce Solutions including Contingent Staffing, SOW-Project Based Services, Recruitment Process Outsourcing, and NOC Services & Support.  Artech has an estimated $920M annual revenue run rate for 2024 and approximately 11,500 employees and consultants across the U.S., Canada, India, and the Philippines.    

Artech is a minority- and women-owned business enterprise (MWBE) and is ranked the #1 largest women-owned IT staffing firm in the US and the #11 largest IT staffing firm in the US by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA).  The company is very active in the diversity community and its president, Ranjini Poddar, has served on the WBENC Board of Directors and was the WBE Co-chair for the WBENC National Conference in 2009 and again in 2013. Artech is an NMSDC Corporate Plus® member and won the prestigious NMSDC National Supplier of the Year award in 2009 – this is the highest honor a minority supplier can receive.  Artech is also certified by the Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC), and the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC).  

As the largest woman-owned IT Staffing firm in the United States, Artech is committed, both in practice and in principle, to helping underrepresented populations of workers explore and expand their careers in Information Technology and other STEM disciplines. As a supplier, Artech provides a platform for diversity spend that goes beyond our certification as both Woman and Minority owned.  While diverse supply chain initiatives help meet both internal diversity spend initiatives, Artech focuses on the gains that can be made in actual worker participation rates. 

Artech currently employs over 6,400 contractors coast-to-coast across the U.S., supporting more than 85 Fortune 500 and government clients.  Artech’s global headquarters is in located Morristown, NJ, and the firm maintains a strategic presence up and down the eastern seaboard in Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida.  In the Midwest and Southwest, Artech has several offices in major metropolitan areas such as Chicago, Minneapolis, Dallas, and Phoenix.  On the West Coast, Artech is strongly represented by five offices / service delivery centers in California, Arizona and Washington.

Artech has extensive staff augmentation experience in both IT and non-IT categories.  Artech provides a variety of workforce solutions to meet the needs of its clients in support of job categories such as Information Technology (IT); Engineering; Professional and Managerial; Scientific, Clinical and regulatory; HR; Legal; Sales and Marketing; Design; and Finance and Accounting.   

Artech supports a variety of commercial and government clients, including over 85 Fortune 500 and Global 500 clients worldwide.  Besides its leadership in staff augmentation services in areas such as IT, Professional and Engineering, Artech also specializes in supporting such niche areas as big data, business intelligence and data warehousing, cloud computing, mobility, and ERP solutions for clients such as IBM, Intel, Accenture, Wells Fargo, Google, Best Buy, Expedia, Capital One, DXC Technology, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and others.

All Artech services are supported by a holistic workflow methodology that ties together its dedicated team structure and single point of contact, mature recruiting process, and cutting-edge tools (people, processes and technology) to generate one continuous workflow stream.

Over the last 32 years, Artech has grown every year because of its strong belief in investments into new and innovative technology platforms, human capital, process driven operations management, and conservative financial policies. Artech’s social investments include long term support to programs including advancement of Women in STEM, child education and funding of various autoimmunity based medical research initiatives in partnership with leading institutions such as Yale Medicine and Hackensack University Medical Center.
